mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases present-value weights on future cash flows, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro easing regimes, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected future cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of FEDFUNDS > 5.25% regimes, or the 60-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of PAYEMS > 100,000 regimes, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 90,000 jobs indicates weakening labor demand, which compresses earnings growth expectations and raises risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of PAYEMS < 90,000 regimes, or the 60-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals robust manufacturing activity, which reduces near-term supply constraints and raises growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of INDPRO > 102.5 regimes, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 indicates supply-side softness, which compresses growth expectations and increases risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX achieves positive 60-day forward returns in > 70% of INDPRO < 100 regimes, or the 60-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly housing starts (HOUST) below 1,300 units indicates cooling housing demand, which compresses long-term growth expectations and raises risk premia, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of HOUST < 1,300 regimes, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly housing starts (HOUST) above 1,400 units signals a rebound in housing demand, which boosts long-term growth expectations and reduces risk aversion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 70% of HOUST > 1,400 regimes, or the 60-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).
